messages.content: 在撲克牌中獲得一副葫蘆的機率是多少？

function.name: poker_probability_full_house
function.description: Calculate the probability of getting a full house in a poker game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

deck_size.description: The size of the deck. Default is 52.

hand_size.description: The size of the hand. Default is 5.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "在撲克牌中獲得一副葫蘆的機率是多少？" which means "What is the probability of getting a full house in a poker hand?" They want the probability. We can compute using combinatorics: For standard 52-card deck, 5-card hand. Full house: 3 cards of one rank and 2 cards of another rank. Number of ways: choose rank for triple: C(13,1) * choose 3 suits from 4: C(4,3). Choose rank for pair: C(12,1) * choose 2 suits from 4: C(4,2). Multiply: 13*C(4,3)*12*C(4,2). Compute: C(4,3)=4; C(4,2)=6. So 13*4*12*6 = 13*4=52; 12*6=72; 52*72 = 3744. Total 5-card hands: C(52,5)=2,598,960. Probability = 3744 / 2598960 ≈ 0.001440576. So about 0.144%. So answer: 3744/2598960 ≈ 0.00144.
